narrative.overview:
The page is the team list sheet a VGC player hands the judge: a white printed form lying on a sand desk, ruled in navy, with everything the tool knows written in cobalt ink. Printed text is near-black navy; anything filled in is cobalt. Navy is the form, cobalt is the pen.

Density is calm and ruled rather than carded. Sections are separated by heavy 2px navy rules, rows by 1px rules, and each section invents the form its question needs. There are no gradients, glows, glass, soft shadows or rounded cards. Corners are square or 2px. Depth comes from tonal sand bands and rules only.
keyCharacteristics: White sheet (max 1240px) on a sand desk, bounded by 1px navy side rules.
Navy for print, cobalt for ink; one committed cobalt field per page (the closing block).
One grotesque, Archivo variable, used in two widths: normal and condensed-caps labels.
Pen marks (rings, ticks) are drawn SVG strokes, never a script face.
Motion is written-in: text revealed left to right, rules drawn across, nothing loops.

rules.name: The Print and Ink Rule
rules.body: Navy is what the form says; cobalt is what was written into it. Never set body copy in cobalt, and never set a printed label in cobalt.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Cobalt fills a whole block only once per page, at the close. Elsewhere cobalt appears as text, a button, a hairline or a pen stroke.

rules.name: The Field Label Rule
rules.body: A condensed-caps label exists only to name a filled-in entry beside or beneath it, as on a form. It never sits above a heading as a lead-in.

rules.name: The No Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A hover changes color, underline or arrow position; it never raises a surface.

dos: Do set printed text and every rule in Print Navy (#17203a) and set only filled-in content in Cobalt Ink (#0047ab).
Do open each section with a 2px navy rule and divide rows with 1px rules.
Do give each section the form its question needs (figure row, checklist, prompt/answer grid) rather than repeating a card.
Do use Print Navy Secondary (#4a5470) for fine print so it stays at 7:1 on white.
Do build new entrances from rise, write, draw-rule or pen, with the expo-out curve, and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't use gradients, glows, glass, soft shadows, or rounded cards; the form is flat and ruled.
Don't use a handwriting font or emoji for pen marks; marks are drawn SVG strokes.
Don't fill more than one block with cobalt per page.
Don't put condensed-caps labels above headings as a lead-in; they name entries only.
Don't set body paragraphs in cobalt.
